facts.text: Backstory: long ago the War of the Magi scorched the world and magic ceased to exist.
Intro: some would enslave the world by reviving the destructive force known as magic.
Intro narration warns that those in power may be about to repeat a senseless, deadly mistake.
After the intro narration, a night scene shows a snowy cliff ledge; holding Down there did nothing (likely cutscene).
On the night snowy-ledge scene, pressing A repeatedly did nothing.
On the snowy-ledge night scene, holding Up also did nothing; three armored mech riders stand there, one green-haired.
Vicks is a speaking character in the snowy-cliff scene with three mech-armor riders (one green-haired).
Vicks says "There's the town…" on the snowy cliff path; the riders are overlooking a town.
Vicks calls the woman in the mech-rider group a 'sorcerer' and questions why she is with them.
Intro cutscene dialogue ignored repeated A presses on Vicks's line; it likely auto-advances on a timer.
Wedge is the other named rider with Vicks on the snowy cliff.
Vicks asks if 'it' is still alive; Wedge says probably, judging from some urgency.
In the snowy town, Terra's party of three is controllable on rooftops/ledges; a grated path leads north.
Snowy town has an INN; from the grated walkway just left of it, walking straight UP did not work.
A large gateway lies to the north of the INN area in the snowy town.
The snowy town is Narshe.
Narshe GUARDs confront our party, recognizing our mechs as Imperial Magitek Armor.
In mech battles the command menu is MagiTek / Item; choose MagiTek, then a beam, then a target.
Terra shows as '?????' on the battle screen; allies are Wedge and Vicks.
Wedge/Vicks mech beam list: Fire Beam (top-left), Bolt Beam (top-right), Ice Beam, Heal Force.
In Narshe's streets, Guards attack our mech party; first seen as a battle against two Guards.
Terra's MagiTek list has 8 skills: Fire, Bolt, Ice Beam, Bio Blast, Heal Force, Confuser, X-fer, TekMissile.
Winning a Narshe street battle gave 32 Exp; the victory box waits for A to advance.
In a Narshe cave/mine with rail tracks, a twinkling sparkle sits on the floor up-left of where Terra stood.
In the Narshe mine, walking UP+LEFT from the rocky ledge made no progress; floor extends up-right toward rail tracks.
In the Narshe mine, walking UP+RIGHT toward the tracks and wooden structure produced no progress.
In the Narshe mine, walking straight UP toward the flame from near the tracks was blocked.
At a Narshe mine track crossing, a blue sparkle (likely save point) lies left; a vertical track leads north.
At the Narshe mine track crossing, walking straight UP along the vertical track made no progress after 3 tries.
At the Narshe mine track crossing, walking LEFT toward the blue sparkle produced no progress after 3 tries.
At the Narshe mine track junction, walking DOWN made no progress; a dark gap lies south.
At the Narshe mine track junction, walking RIGHT onto the wooden walkway also made no progress after 3 tries.
A Narshe cave battle pits our party against two foes: a green-clad hunched enemy and a pale creature with a red top.
In battle with the MagiTek list open, the 'dialogue' A-press directive showed no change; use explicit cursor + A presses.
Narshe cave enemies are named Were-Rat and Repo Man.
START toggles battle pause: never press it repeatedly; if the battle looks frozen, one press then wait.
Terra's two soldier allies are Wedge and Vicks; Terra shows as '?????' on the battle screen.
Won a Narshe cave battle that awarded 47 GP; a 'Got GP' box appears on the victory screen.
Opening intro narration (War of the Magi) over a cliff scene plays on its own; just wait, press nothing.
Opening snowy cliff dialogue: a soldier says 'she' fried 50 Magitek Armored soldiers in under 3 minutes.
Opening cliff scene: pressing A on Wedge's dialogue did nothing; it seems to auto-advance, so wait.
Terra (?????) was knocked out (HP 0) in a Narshe cave battle against three Were-Rats; revive with a Fenix Down.
MagiTek skill list in battle shows Fire Beam, Bolt Beam, Ice Beam, Heal Force.
In battle, a blank blue list window with up/down arrows is an empty sub-list; back out with B before choosing a command.
In the Narshe mine cave, a prompt offers info about Save Points (Yes/No), so a Save Point is at or near this spot.
After the cave battles Terra is still KO'd (HP 0); use a Fenix Down on her from the X menu once free to walk.
The blue-white sparkle on the Narshe mine cave tracks is likely the Save Point; the party was standing at it.
At Save Points you can use a Sleeping Bag or Tent, and also save the game.
If walking does nothing at the Save Point, a message box is open; advance it with A first.
Save Point tutorial: if you perish, you can automatically play from your last save.
In the Narshe cave plank/rail area, walking RIGHT from the center spot was blocked; try other directions.
Trying to revive Terra via the X menu failed repeatedly; close the menu with B and continue the story for now.
From the Narshe mine Save Point, the way onward is right and then up along the path (per human coach).
In the Narshe cave rail area, walking UP from the center spot was also blocked.
In the Narshe cave rail area, walking DOWN+RIGHT from the center spot under the lamp frame was also blocked.
Movement is 4-way only (Up, Down, Left, Right); never use diagonal directions.
In the Narshe cave rail area, a wooden stairway at the up-left is a possible exit; the track continues north.
Below the wooden frame in the Narshe cave, the plank track leads down to a horizontal track heading right.
Human route in the Narshe cave: go up until a wall stops you, then go right (resume after any battle).
Were-Rats are random-battle enemies in the Narshe mine cave.
In battle, Magitek menu offers Fire Beam, Bolt Beam, Ice Beam, Heal Force; A on Fire Beam then A on target attacks.
Terra's battle allies are Wedge and Vicks; Terra shows as ????? in battle.
In battle, a white hand cursor beside an enemy means target select: one A press confirms the attack.
From the spot under the wooden frame on the vertical track, walking DOWN produced no movement.
Newest human route in Narshe cave: go UP, then RIGHT, then UP and go through the bars.
Latest human route in Narshe cave: go LEFT, stop at the wooden path, then go UP.
In the Narshe cave, walking LEFT from the spot right of the wooden grated stairs gave no movement.
A Vicks dialogue ('I'll handle this. Stand back!') appears on the Narshe cave path, which blocks walking until advanced.
Narshe cave torch passage: a path leads north between two torches; the wooden track runs down to the south-west.
Narshe cave: the tunnel is a dark floor path going up between two wooden supports, between torches; coach says go up it.
In the Narshe cave torch passage, pushing UP from the current spot failed 3 times; need to line up sideways first.
In the Narshe cave torch passage, walking RIGHT from the blocked spot also gave no movement.
In the Narshe cave torch passage, walking LEFT from the blocked spot gave no movement after 3 tries.
Latest coach route in Narshe torch passage: 2 steps RIGHT, then go UP.
Narshe torch passage: the coach's RIGHT step gave no movement after 3 tries; a wooden walkway exit lies down-left.
Narshe torch passage: walking DOWN+LEFT from the blocked spot also gave no movement after 3 tries.
Human order: stop walking and stay put until the human says to move again.
Terra is KO'd (0/63 HP) and needs a Fenix Down or other revive.
Latest human order: take 2 steps to the right, then stop.
Right step from the spot between the two cave lanterns is blocked; north path is open but awaits a human order.
Latest human order: walk UP and don't stop unless something stops you.
Narshe torch passage: UP is stopped after 3 tries (north end walled); next probe is straight DOWN toward the plank walkway.
A Narshe cave guard says 'We won't hand over the Esper!!'; the open box blocks walking until advanced with A.
In the Narshe torch passage, pressing A on the empty blue top window changed nothing after 3 tries.
A Narshe cave guard shouts 'Whelk! Get them!' in the torch passage, likely heralding a Whelk fight.
Whelk battle has started in the Narshe cave; Vicks speaks up at the start with 'Hold it!'.
Whelk fight: attack only the golden head; when it hides in the shell, don't attack the shell (it counters).
During the Whelk battle, Vicks's opening box shows 'Hold it! Think bac...'; repeated single A presses showed no change.
Vicks warns during the Whelk fight: 'Do you recall hearing about a monster that eats lightning……'
Whelk fight: Terra is KO'd; the two other riders are alive. Avoid Bolt Beam; use Fire/Ice Beam on the head.
Surviving riders' battle beam menu: Fire Beam, Bolt Beam, Ice Beam, Heal Force.
In the Whelk battle the riders are listed as WEDGE, VICKS and ????? (Terra, shown at 0 HP).
Whelk shell with an empty dark opening on its right likely means the head is hidden; use Heal Force on allies then.
Whelk fight: Wedge dropped to 4 HP with Vicks at 65; Wedge needs Heal Force urgently.
Whelk fight: memory shows riders at 67 and 65 HP, so an on-screen 'WEDGE 4' reading may be a truncated misread.
Whelk fight: latest screen shows WEDGE 0, VICKS 56, ????? 0, so Vicks may be the only rider left standing.
Whelk fight: blind repeated A presses did nothing; wait for a command menu, and check cursor text before confirming.
Beam menu cursor defaults to Fire Beam: move it onto Heal Force and verify before pressing A when healing.
Whelk fight was lost: party Annihilated. On retry, heal early with Heal Force and never attack the shell.
Memory confirms all three party members at 0 HP in the Whelk battle: defeat is final, no healing possible; await reload.
After the Whelk defeat, a static near-black screen with one brown-clad sprite and no text box appears.
On the post-defeat dark screen, 3 attempts at single A presses produced no change.
A dark mine-track cave has a blue sparkle (likely a save point) left of the player; tracks run north, east and south.
In the mine-track cave, walking LEFT from beside the horizontal track toward the sparkle produced no change.
In the mine-track cave, walking DOWN from the starting spot also produced no change after 3 attempts.
In the blue cave area, walking UP toward the upper sparkle produced no change after 3 attempts.
In the mine-track cave, walking RIGHT toward the plank walkway also failed; UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT all tried.
In the dark mine cave, the human coach says to follow the track path north (UP).
In the mine-track cave, the latest UP attempt on the track also produced no change after 3 tries.
In the cave, a battle with three Were-Rats began with ????? (Terra) at 0 HP; Wedge and Vicks were still standing.
